03/03/2010: Station Maintenance:                                        [0005] 
 
            - Loaded Customized MAWN Program (MAWN_HVLF), which not 
              only powers the modem on an hourly schedule, but also 
              collects data from the following new sensor: 
 
                 Air Temperature @ 06" height 
 
              Data from this new sensor is available in both "hourly" 
              and "daily" records, starting at the following time: 
 
                 03/03/2010 (d=062) 00:05

08/20/2008: Data Removal: 
 
            - The Soil Temp B (4") sensor was replaced on 08/13/08.  It 
              had been reporting faulty data since Jul 16, 2008.  Therefore, 
              the 4" Soil Temperature data was removed from both the  
              archived raw data files as well as from the MAWN database 
              for the following time period: 
 
                 07/16/08 (d=198) 21:00  -  08/13/08 (d=226) 11:00 
 
 
05/20/2008: Station Maintenance: 
 
            - General station maintenance and system checks, including: 
              - Soil Moisture sensors now installed vertically: 
                - MSTR 0:  profile of depth =  0 - 12" 
                - MSTR 1:  profile of depth = 12 - 24" 
 
            - Work was done approx: 11:00 - 1200 (Day=141)

            - It was determined that several months of faulty solar 
              radiation data has existed in the archive for Hudsonville. 
              All solar radiation data between the following dates has 
              been removed: 
 
                 Oct 01, 2006 [00:00]  -  May 16, 2007 [24:00]

10/13/2006: Station Maintenance (jb): 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program:   MAWN_AACF (00:05) 
 
 
08/14/2006: Station Maintenance (bn): 
 
            - Troubleshooting random data outages at :05 and :35 past 
              the hour continues... 
 
              - Datalogger (CR10X) Replaced 
              - Loaded New MAWN Program:   AACS (CS615, hourly voltage) 
 
            - Work was performed at:  1330 - 1415  
 
 
08/03/2006: Station Maintenance (sm, bn): 
 
            - Random outages at :05 and :35 past the hour led to 
              an investigation of the Hudsonville MAWM station.  The 
              Temp/RH sensor was covered with an insect nest.  The 
              Temp/RH sensor and battery supply unit were replaced. 
 
06/15/2006: Data Quality (jtb): 
 
            - Leaf Wetness A was found covered with bird droppings which  
              lead to faulty leaf wetness readings.   The faulty data  
              appears to have started on Apr 07, 2006. 
 
            - Leaf Wetness A values have been marked as "missing" for the 
              following time period: 
 
                    04/07/06 01:20  -  06/15/06 16:00 
 
 
06/15/2006: Station Maintenance: (sm): 
 
            - Communication converted to broadband cell-modem: 
 
              - Broadband Cell modem installed. 
              - Datalogger Program "mawn_bacs" Loaded and Compiled 
              - Data Collection Configured To Upload Every 30 minutes. 
 
            - General Station Maintenance and System Checks: 
              - weed removal and application of Round-Up above soil temps 
              - sensor placement checked 
              - anemometer bearings checked 
              - rain gauge checked for debris 
              - leaf wetness 0 was found covered with bird droppings.  The 
                sensor was cleaned. 
 
            - Work was done approx: 15:10 - 16:00 (Day=166)

07/09/2002: Maintenance: 
 
            - Tipping bucket rain gauge was obstructed and was  
              unplugged around 8:30am by Dwayne Frens of the 
              Michigan Celery Cooperative.   
 
            - The five-minute precipitation total recorded at 
              08:35 and the hourly total reported at 09:00 are 
              therefore likely to be inflated. 
 
            - Manual precipitation observation taken at the  
              Michigan Celery Cooperative measured 2.78 inches 
              (storm total). 
 
 
04/08/2002: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
            - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
              from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=410.
